lead: Prathap K. Pothan was an Indian film director, born on 13 August 1952 in Thiruvananthapuram.
He died on 15 July 2022 in Chennai at the age of 69.
He has 49 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Awards South and Indira Gandhi Award for Best First Film of a Director.
The sections that follow break down Prathap K. Pothan's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
